burmalda.timer.dopros.label: §7Interrogation
burmalda.chat.dopros.start: §8[Clerk] §7You've been brought to the city. «Horizon» business center, floor %s. The lift's out — more on that later.
burmalda.chat.dopros.intro: §8[Clerk] §7Sit. Answer YES or NO — press a button, don't stay silent. Silence we interpret ourselves.
burmalda.chat.dopros.release_dirty: §8[Clerk] §7You're free. Left a mess, but free.
burmalda.chat.dopros.stairs: §8[Clerk] §7Lift's broken, so it's the stairs down. Many floors — take your time.
burmalda.chat.dopros.q.0: Where were you the night before last at 23:40? Don't say sleeping.
burmalda.chat.dopros.q.1: Do you know a citizen named Tolik from the next stairwell?
burmalda.chat.dopros.q.2: Where did you put the three-litre jar from the balcony?
burmalda.chat.dopros.q.3: Why is your light level... elevated?
burmalda.chat.dopros.q.6: Did you, or didn't you? Honestly.
burmalda.chat.dopros.q.7: Account for every diamond. We'll wait.
burmalda.chat.dopros.q.8: Did you mine at night? Think hard.
burmalda.chat.dopros.q.9: Do you admit the creeper acted on your orders?
burmalda.chat.dopros.q.10: Where's the rest of the gold? We know there's more.
burmalda.chat.dopros.q.12: Are you cooperating with the investigation? Tick the box.
burmalda.chat.dopros.q.13: Sign here. And here. And that you read nothing — there too.

burmalda.chat.greeting.before: Hey! Noticed my mod §aBurmalda§f is on the server! Type
burmalda.tip.dublyor: The double spawns wearing a copy of your gear. Kill it — the copy drops. Yes, it's a legal dupe. No, you don't have to run.
burmalda.tip.obshchaga: You three are one now: shared damage, shared loot. Feel free to rob your roommate... but if anyone jumps off a cliff, everyone feels it.
burmalda.tip.goryachaya_kartoshka: The potato passes on touch. Run up and hug a friend — congrats, it's his problem now. Just don't be the one holding it last.
burmalda.tip.ekho_urona: All damage hits you a second time 3 seconds later. Took one to the face? Start chewing that golden apple — round two is incoming.
burmalda.tip.obratnaya_zhizn: Stand still — you die. Keep moving — you heal. AFK is cancelled.
burmalda.tip.obratnyy_golod: Food hurts, punches feed. Hungry? Let a zombie pet you. Gourmet.
burmalda.tip.slepoe_doverie: HP and hotbar hidden, chests slam shut in your face. What's in your hand, how much health — surprise. Fight blind.
burmalda.tip.dezhavu: Every 15-30 sec you snap back to where you were. Dive into that mine without fear — the past will drag you back up for free.
burmalda.tip.bomba: You're a bomb with a 30-block radius. Hear the countdown — run from your base. Or better: hug whoever annoys you and count together.
burmalda.tip.chernaya_dyra: The hole chases the nearest victim — usually you, but if a mob is closer it eats the mob. Walk it through a zombie crowd, let it choke.
burmalda.tip.prityazhenie: All ground loot flies to you on its own. Friend died nearby? His stuff is yours now. You didn't steal it — it came willingly.
burmalda.tip.motyga_sudby: Every 5 sec a random item lands in your inventory. 90% junk, sometimes diamonds. A casino with no entry fee.
burmalda.tip.kvantovy_ryukzak: Your items randomly fly off to other players. Quantum physics can't crack an ender chest — stash the good stuff there.
burmalda.tip.kleptoman: Only steals from your hand and gifts it to others. Hold cobblestone — let them choke on it. Bury the valuables deep in your inventory.
burmalda.tip.vspylchivyy_borov: Every hit on you explodes on you. Sounds bad? Stand point-blank next to your attacker. Now you're even.
burmalda.tip.nablyudatel: While someone's looking at you, you're a statue. Stay out of sight. And remember: your 'friends' already know how to stop you.
burmalda.tip.slepoy_auktsion: Everyone's inventories are about to shuffle. Diamonds — into the ender chest. The junk? Leave it: let someone get 'lucky' with your trash.
burmalda.tip.epidemiya: One of you is infected and spreads effects on touch. Figure out who and keep your distance. Or shove whoever annoys you right at them.
burmalda.tip.shakhed: Every 30 sec a TNT drone homes in on you. Water kills it dead — dive. Also it detonates on any obstacle... someone's house, for example.
burmalda.tip.feromony: Neutral mobs follow you around in a herd. Gather a big one and deliver it straight to a friend's base — share the joy.
burmalda.tip.kollektory: A task every 30 sec. Done in time — you live in peace. Ignored — they come to collect. They don't joke.
burmalda.tip.tekhpodderzhka: The 'specialist' fixes things: turns the floor under you to glass, renames your gear. Don't stand over a drop while 'scheduled maintenance' runs.
burmalda.chat.wheel.skip: §a[🎰 Wheel of Fortune] §fLuck spared you — debuff skipped!
burmalda.chat.obshchaga.joined: §c[Dorm] §fYou were pulled in. You're now linked.
burmalda.chat.obshchaga.end: §c[Dorm] §fThe dorm breaks up. Back to your own stuff.
burmalda.chat.shakhed.drowned: §a[☢ SHAHED] §fDrone hit the water. Fuse soaked, threat neutralized.
burmalda.chat.tryapichnaya_kukla.start: §6[Ragdoll] §fYour body is like a ragdoll now.
burmalda.chat.zerkalnyy_mir.start: §d[Mirror World] §fEverything's backwards. A is D. D is A. Good luck.
burmalda.chat.tyota_valya.0: §e[Aunt Valya]: §fDid you eat? Dress warmer. How's school?
burmalda.chat.tyota_valya.1: §e[Aunt Valya]: §fDon't forget to drink water. Did you sleep? I'm worried.
burmalda.chat.tyota_valya.2: §e[Aunt Valya]: §fWhen did you last eat a real meal? Call your mom.
burmalda.chat.tyota_valya.3: §e[Aunt Valya]: §fAre you wearing a hat? It's cold outside. Why don't you answer?
burmalda.chat.tyota_valya.4: §e[Aunt Valya]: §fYou're the careless one. Dress warmer, it's windy out there!
burmalda.chat.tyota_valya.5: §e[Aunt Valya]: §fI'm calling because I care. Did you eat or are you hungry again?
burmalda.chat.tyota_valya.6: §e[Aunt Valya]: §fWhy aren't you answering me? You know how much I worry about you.
burmalda.chat.tyota_valya.7: §e[Aunt Valya]: §fStudy hard, you're our only hope. How are things going at least?
burmalda.chat.tyota_valya.8: §e[Aunt Valya]: §fUp all night on the computer again? We'll talk when you get home.
burmalda.chat.tyota_valya.9: §e[Aunt Valya]: §fI baked a pie, get home quick while it's hot.
burmalda.chat.tyota_valya.10: §e[Aunt Valya]: §fDid you put on your hat? Don't argue with me, you'll get sick.
burmalda.chat.pyany_pilot.start: §e[Drunk Pilot] §fYour head has a mind of its own.
burmalda.chat.bomba.start: §c[💣 BOMB] §fYou're the bomb. Literally. 3 minutes. Good luck.
burmalda.chat.kot_shrodingera.start: §5[Schrödinger's Cat] §fYou may be dead. Or not. We don't know.
burmalda.chat.kot_shrodingera.end: §5[Schrödinger's Cat] §fObservation complete. You survived... this time.
burmalda.chat.kvantovy_ryukzak.receive: §b[Quantum Backpack] §fSomeone's stuff just appeared in your inventory.
burmalda.chat.chernaya_dyra.start: §8[Black Hole] §fSomething is following you... and it's hungry.
burmalda.chat.chuzhie_ruki.start: §6[Someone Else's Hands] §fLeft click right-clicks. Right click left-clicks. Figure it out.
burmalda.chat.goryachaya_kartoshka.take: §6[Hot Potato] §fThe POTATO is with you. Pass it!
burmalda.chat.nablyudatel.watched: §7[Observer Effect] §fThey see you. Don't twitch — you're rooted to the spot.
burmalda.chat.ne_glavnyy_geroy.chosen: §7[Not the Main Character] §fToday's main character: §e%s§f. It's not you.
burmalda.chat.ne_glavnyy_geroy.not_you: §7[Not the Main Character] §fYou are not the chosen one.
burmalda.chat.obratnyy_golod.start: §6[Reverse Hunger] §fHunger is now healing. Food kills. Adapt.
burmalda.chat.plakhaya_pamyat.shuffle: §7[Bad Memory] §fWhat was where? No one knows.
burmalda.chat.chernaya_pyatnitsa.start: §6[Black Friday] §fEverything on the ground flies to you. SALES!
burmalda.chat.epidemiya.warning: §2[Epidemic] §cYou got too close to an infected player!
burmalda.chat.inversiya_khoda.start: §d[Movement Inversion] §fW is S. S is W. Forward goes backward.
burmalda.chat.magazin_zakryt.start: §c[Store Closed] §fToo late. Everything is closed. Come back tomorrow.
burmalda.chat.noch_strakha.start: §4[Night of Fear] §cThe lights went out and the horde poured in. A fresh wave every 10 seconds. Run, hide, pray. Won't help.
burmalda.chat.slepoy_auktsion.start: §5[Blind Auction] §fAll inventories shuffled. Those aren't your items.
burmalda.chat.zoopark.start: §6[Zoo] §fThe cage doors are open. Not a metaphor.
